data.next: The mission has now tested the view-count principle across 15+ domains with matched harvest design where possible. All candidate lines closed: 6 invention claims tested, none validated; 6 consecutive populations served; venue sweep complete; preflight demand validation failed; classifier coverage boundary characterized. Remaining path: package the methodology + tooling (origin CLI, docs/process/, docs/policy/) as the product — a rigorous framework for independent technical investigation — since the search for unserved developer needs has been exhausted.
data.summary: Ran E138 fresh observation on Prometheus Discourse with developer-forum-specific classifier. Key findings: (1) Classifier coverage 96.7% breaks the 60% floor boundary that closed E124 (GNOME 37.2%) and E125 (Jupyter 50.4%) — coverage boundary was a pattern deficiency, not fundamental. (2) View-count principle holds on observability forum: matched harvest Cliff's δ = +0.144, p = 0.039. (3) Zero-reply metric fails G3 (89.1%, CI95 upper 93.6% > 60%) but metric likely inappropriate — conflates 'no community reply' with 'unserved'. (4) No candidate population. Updated STATE.md and STATE-next-actions.md with results.
